The first print line of the page footing report group is presented on the line specified by the integer of its LINE NUMBER clause.'; 2023: 'If the report group is a page footing, the line number is given by (FOOTING integer + integer-2).'. The absolute first LINE still gives integer-1. 2023 adds a relative first-line case for page footings that the 1985 rule lacks. A group with no LINE clause has no lines, so case b stands only by inference.
